answer: Water is present in this scene, as confirmed by both optical and SAR analysis. The SAR tool detected 266 water pixels (0.41% of the scene), while the optical tool identified 10,770 water pixels (16.43%). The intersection of both masks contains only 123 pixels, yielding an IoU of 0.011, indicating low agreement between the two methods. The SAR water mask is calibrated and based on a VV backscatter threshold of -16.0 dB. The optical mask was derived using an RGB Otsu threshold on (B-R) bands. The scene contains a river visible in the lower right quadrant, consistent with water features. The coregistration check indicates a weak peak correlation, suggesting potential misalignment between the optical and SAR data.
